text: Governor Bolt boosts spending in Coopville: new building projects worth 4% of the economy.
Coopville's town hall argues for hours. 38 of 60 vote to change nothing.
Governor Bolt keeps Coopville's spending steady this year.
Harvests fail, and the shared forest and lake shrink by 30%. Prices start climbing.
Coopville's town hall votes 46 of 60 to raise free money for all to 8% of typical pay.
Governor Bolt wins the election in Coopville with 52% of the vote.
Coopville's town hall argues for hours. 48 of 60 vote to change nothing.
Harvests fail, and the shared forest and lake shrink by 30%. Prices start climbing.
Prices in Coopville are rising 22% a year.
The shared forest and lake are down to 29%. People take more than grows back.
Governor Bolt wins re-election in Coopville with 56% of the vote.
Governor Bolt hits the term limit and steps down in Coopville.
Governor Ivan replaces Bolt in Coopville after the election.
